advancedArguments.name: isAttachmentMandatory
advancedArguments.description: Set to true when the leave type requires a mandatory attachment (e.g., medical leave). When true, Set this field to true if the user is applying for one of the following leave types: Annual Leave, Sick Leave, or Maternity Leave.

raw.description: Set to true when the leave type requires a mandatory attachment (e.g., medical leave). When true, Set this field to true if the user is applying for one of the following leave types: Annual Leave, Sick Leave, or Maternity Leave.

advancedArguments.name: dayModes
advancedArguments.description: Array containing each individual leave date and its corresponding day mode. Based on the from and to date range, the system will generate all dates in between and ask the user to specify the day mode for each date. For example, if user applies for 3-day leave, there will be 3 items in this array - each with a specific date and its day mode selection.

date.description: Individual leave date within the from and to date range. Example: '2025-09-23T00:00:00' - must be in ISO date format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss'.

dayMode.description: user ask available day modes front disply name corresponding values selected corresponding day mode ids will be take other then no need default values will be take ask user evry day day modes,Day mode based on user's leave mode selection: 'Whole Day' = 2, 'First Half' = 1, 'Second Half' = 0, 'Off Day' = 7. User selects leave mode name and corresponding numeric value will be used. Display the mode names to user, not the numeric values.

dayValue.description: user ask available day modes front disply name corresponding values selected corresponding day mode value will be take other then no need default values will be take ask user evry day day modes,Day mode based on user's leave mode selection: 'Whole Day' = 1, 'First Half' = 0.5, 'Second Half' = 0.5, 'Off Day' = 0. User selects leave mode name and corresponding numeric value will be used. Display the mode names to user, not the numeric values.

raw.description: Array containing each individual leave date and its corresponding day mode. Based on the from and to date range, the system will generate all dates in between and ask the user to specify the day mode for each date. For example, if user applies for 3-day leave, there will be 3 items in this array - each with a specific date and its day mode selection.

advancedArguments.name: confirmed
advancedArguments.description: Set to true only after the user has seen the preview the tool returned (dates, day modes, total days, comment) and has explicitly agreed to submit. Omit or set false to preview and validate without saving anything.

raw.description: Set to true only after the user has seen the preview the tool returned (dates, day modes, total days, comment) and has explicitly agreed to submit. Omit or set false to preview and validate without saving anything.
